title: Pure Garbage
summary: The Garbage archetype revolves around Dr. Faker's DARK Fiend engine of Garbage Lord, Garbage Ogre, and Garbage Golem. By paying LP to Special Summon multiple copies of Garbage Lord without once-per-turn limits, the deck quickly accesses Rank 5 DARK Xyz bosses like Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon and Number 53: Heart-eartH, which floats into the devastating game-ending boss Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Normal Summon starter that summons Level 3 DARK Fiend Garbage Ogre or Sangan from the Deck.
allow.Sangan: Level 3 DARK Fiend that searches Garbage Ogre, Garbage Golem, or Garbage Lord (all have 1500 or less ATK!) when linked off.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Garbage Golem directly to the GY to trigger its GY banish effect (detaching 1 material to revive Garbage Lord).
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards and banishes excess DARK Fiends.
allow.Number 53: Heart-eartH: Dr. Faker's signature Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz (0 ATK / 0 DEF!) made with Level 5 Garbage Lords that floats into Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon.
allow.Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon: Rank 9 DARK Dragon Xyz (0 ATK / 0 DEF) cheated out by Number 53 that reflects battle damage and banishes the opponent's board.
allow.Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon: Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz summonable using two Level 5 Garbage Lords (satisfying Garbage Lord's DARK Xyz restriction) that detaches 1 material to destroy a face-up card.
allow.D/D/D Marksman King Tell: Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz that can be ranked up or summoned to burn and send Garbage Golem from the Deck to the GY.
allow.D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex: Rank 10 DARK Fiend Xyz that stacks directly over any D/D/D Xyz (Marksman King Tell) to absorb opposing monsters when they activate effects.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend that discards a card to revive Garbage Lord or Garbage Golem from the GY.

main: Level 5 DARK Fiend (0 ATK / 2400 DEF) that pays 2000 LP to Special Summon itself from the hand (not once per turn!) to assemble Rank 5 DARK Xyz monsters.
Level 3 DARK Fiend that sends itself from your hand to the GY to add 1 Garbage Lord from your Deck to your hand.

Level 4 DARK Fiend: Special Summons itself while you control a 0 ATK/DEF monster (Garbage Lord), reveals 3 different-Rank Xyz to pop itself and a card, and banishes from GY to detach 1 Xyz Material and revive a 0 ATK/DEF monster.
Level 2 Cyberse that bounces another Cyberse or acts as an archetypal Garbage name.
Summons Sangan or Garbage Ogre from the Deck to link into Muckraker From the Underworld and search Garbage Lord.
Searches Garbage Lord (0 ATK), Garbage Ogre (800 ATK), or Garbage Golem when sent from the field to the GY.
Draws 2 cards by banishing a DARK Fiend.
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Garbage Golem or Garbage Lord to the GY.
extra: Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz (2 Level 5 monsters) valid under Garbage Lord's DARK restriction; detaches 1 material to destroy 1 face-up card the opponent controls.
Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz (0 ATK / 0 DEF—valid revival target for Garbage Golem!) that gains attacking monsters' ATK and cheats out Number 92 when destroyed without materials.
Rank 9 DARK Dragon Xyz summoned by Number 53 that banishes all cards Normal/Special Summoned or Set by the opponent this turn.
Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz that detaches 1 material when you take effect damage to burn for 1000 and sends a Fiend to GY when sent to GY.
Rank 10 DARK Fiend Xyz stacked over Marksman King Tell that detaches 2 materials (or destroys a Dark Contract) to attach an opponent's monster that activates an effect.
Link-2 DARK Fiend that revives Garbage Lord or Garbage Golem from the GY.
